name: Project Gutenberg English texts in the public domain
licence_detail: Public domain in the US (texts 'not protected by U.S. copyright law'); the Project Gutenberg licence covers only the trademark and must be stripped with the PG header and footer.
verdict_reason: Public domain, so training and shipping weights needs no licence. PG only guarantees US status, so keep only books whose authors all died before 1956 (public domain under life+70 and India's life+60), and skip any book whose header marks it as copyrighted.
used_for: M3b LM text (training), at a small mix weight: the register is old and literary, unlike chat. Books are selected from the pinned catalogue by training/mlkb/lm/sources.py (Type Text, Language en, every person in Authors with a death year before 1956, in ebook-id order up to 85M words); the ids, SHA-256s and word counts are in data/manifests/gutenberg-books.tsv.
notes: Select books with the PG catalogue (pg_catalog.csv, public domain, about 21 MB, regenerated daily, so pin a dated copy when fetching). Download from a mirror or the robot/harvest endpoint as the robot policy asks, not by crawling the site. The catalogue was pinned on 2026-11-03 (the URL serves a newer file each week, so data/fetch.sh can only verify the pinned copy, not re-download it). Books are downloaded as <id>/pg<id>.txt of the generated collection from the mirror.cs.odu.edu/gutenberg-epub mirror (fallback gutenberg.pglaf.org/cache/epub), both listed in https://www.gutenberg.org/dirs/MIRRORS.ALL, over at most three connections with a pause before each request, never from www.gutenberg.org.
